title: South American Rural Cadastral Boundaries
description: Cadastral (land parcel) boundary polygons for rural land in Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay, mirrored from each country's national cadastre and republished as cloud-native GeoParquet for supply-chain and rural land-use analysis. The three national collections (Brazil's CAR property boundaries, Paraguay's active cadastral parcels, and Uruguay's rural cadastral parcels) use different schemas and none has a unique parcel identifier, so they do not join to one another.

## README.md
# South American Rural Cadastral Boundaries

Cadastral parcel boundaries for South American rural land use and supply chain
analysis, as cloud-native GeoParquet. Three national collections: Brazil,
Paraguay, and Uruguay.

Intended for use alongside [Trazo](https://source.coop/wri-data-lab/trazofields)
agricultural field boundaries and
[Fields of The World](https://source.coop/ftw/global-data).

> *Use case: for parcel-level, multi-parcel analysis — supply chain sourcing,
> for example — the unique ID column of each cadastral dataset is the most
> important field. In some cases it is missing.*

| Collection | Parcels | Currency | Parcel number | Is it unique? |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Brazil — CAR property boundaries](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/brazil-car-area-imovel/README.md) | 8,453,552 | 16 July 2026 | `cod_imovel` | No: 8,437,938 distinct |
| [Paraguay — active cadastral parcels](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/paraguay-parcelas-activas/README.md) | 2,192,890 | downloaded 17 July 2026 | `padron`, `ccatastral` | No: 1,107,044 distinct at best |
| [Uruguay — rural cadastral parcels](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/uruguay-pais-rural/README.md) | 250,074 | 2 February 2025 | `PADRON` | No: 65,605 distinct |

**No collection here has a unique parcel identifier**, and the three do not
join to each other. Deduplicate before you count, and read the collection
README before you join.

Every number on this page was measured over every row of the published file.
Nothing here is a sample or an estimate.

## Uruguay Parcels And Trazo Fields

![Uruguay parcels and Trazo4 fields](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/pageresources/Uruguay%20Parcels%20and%20Trazo4%20Fields.png)

![Uruguay parcels and Trazo4 fields, zoomed in](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/pageresources/Uruguay%20Parcels%20and%20Trazo4%20Fields%20Zoom%20In.png)

![Uruguay parcels and Trazo4 fields, zoomed in further](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/pageresources/Uruguay%20Parcels%20and%20Trazo4%20Fields%20Zoom%20In%202.png)

Uruguayan cadastral parcels in black, with upcoming 2025 Trazo4 agricultural
fields.

## License

**Each collection declares `other`, and each links its own terms. Read that
link before you redistribute.** No SPDX identifier fits any of the three.

| Collection | What the source publishes |
|---|---|
| Brazil, SICAR | Nothing. The AREA_IMOVEL download is gated by a captcha and no terms. Lei 12.651/2012 Art. 29 makes CAR a public electronic registry and says nothing about reuse. |
| Paraguay, SNC | Nothing. The layer's GeoServer capabilities carry unedited defaults, and the layer is not on `datos.gov.py`, so the national open data licence does not attach. |
| Uruguay, DNC | [Licencia de Datos Abiertos — Uruguay v0.1](https://www.gub.uy/agencia-gobierno-electronico-sociedad-informacion-conocimiento/sites/agencia-gobierno-electronico-sociedad-informacion-conocimiento/files/documentos/publicaciones/licencia_de_datos_abiertos_0.pdf). It permits redistribution outright, commercially and non-commercially, with attribution. It is a bespoke national instrument, not on the SPDX list. |

An earlier version of this catalog declared `CC-BY-4.0` on all three. No
upstream source states that. Attribute the producing agency named in each
collection's `providers`. If you need a licence warranty, go to that agency.

## Provenance

This catalog is a **mirror**. None of the three cadastres originate here.

| Collection | Producer | Upstream |
|---|---|---|
| `brazil-car-area-imovel` | Serviço Florestal Brasileiro (SICAR) | [consultapublica.car.gov.br](https://consultapublica.car.gov.br/publico/estados/downloads) |
| `paraguay-parcelas-activas` | Servicio Nacional de Catastro | [catastro.gov.py viewer](https://www.catastro.gov.py/visor/?snc=geo) |
| `uruguay-pais-rural` | Dirección Nacional de Catastro | [catalogodatos.gub.uy](https://catalogodatos.gub.uy/dataset/direccion-nacional-de-catastro-shapes-del-parcelario-rural-y-urbano) |

Each collection carries `updated`, the time its data last reached this bucket.
There is no automatic sync. A refresh is a manual re-download and re-upload.

Every collection was reprojected to EPSG:4326 and rewritten as GeoParquet 1.1
with a bbox covering column and ZSTD compression. No row was filtered, and no
attribute was renamed or dropped.

The catalog metadata is generated from a repository, linked as `rel:vcs` on
`catalog.json`. That repository is private, so the link resolves only for
people who already have access.

## Access

Nothing here needs credentials. Each collection is a single Parquet object
served over plain HTTPS with range support, so a query reads only the row
groups it needs. There is no `partition:glob` anywhere in this catalog, so
nothing here needs `s3://`.

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- Parcel counts by Uruguayan department, over all 250,074 rows.
SELECT NOMDEPTO, count(*) AS parcels, round(sum(AREAHA)) AS hectares
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/uruguay-pais-rural/uruguay_pais_rural.parquet'
GROUP BY NOMDEPTO
ORDER BY parcels DESC
LIMIT 5;
-- CANELONES 41650 407925 | ROCHA 20458 1112034 | MALDONADO 18598 471220
-- COLONIA 17177 613094 | LAVALLEJA 16462 1067110
```

```sql
-- Brazilian CAR parcels inside a bounding box. The bbox covering column lets
-- DuckDB skip row groups, so this reads a fraction of the 3.26 GB file.
SELECT count(*)
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/brazil-car-area-imovel/brazil_car_area_imovel.parquet'
WHERE bbox.xmin > -47.5 AND bbox.xmax < -47.0
  AND bbox.ymin > -16.5 AND bbox.ymax < -16.0;
-- 1470
```

```sql
-- Paraguayan parcels by department, over all 2,192,890 rows.
SELECT dpto, count(*) AS parcels
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/paraguay-parcelas-activas/paraguay_parcelas_activas.parquet'
GROUP BY dpto
ORDER BY parcels DESC
LIMIT 5;
-- L 625210 | K 322064 | D 218172 | H 195289 | F 125765
```

Every query above was run against the published files before it was written
here, and each one carries the output it produced.

## Dataset Composition

### `brazil-car-area-imovel/brazil_car_area_imovel.parquet`

8,453,552 polygons, national coverage, as of 16 July 2026. It replaces the
former root-level `Brazil_CAR_AREA_IMOVEL.parquet`.

Every row carries the single theme `Area do Imovel`, the property perimeter.
CAR also holds theme layers for Permanent Preservation Area, Legal Reserve,
Remnant of Native Vegetation, Consolidated Rural Area, Hydrography and others.
**None of those are in this catalog.** They matter for Brazilian rural land
use and environmental compliance, and a later release can add them.

Two source records with corrupt coordinates moved, unmodified, into the
sidecar `brazil-car-area-imovel/brazil_car_area_imovel_suspect.parquet`, so no
`cod_imovel` is lost. That sidecar is EPSG:4674, not EPSG:4326.

`des_condic` gives the administrative status of the submission and has 16
distinct values, not the 10 an earlier version of this page listed. The full
table with counts is in
[the collection README](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/cadastral/brazil-car-area-imovel/README.md).
Use the polygons whatever their status: flag parcels labelled "Cancelado" but
do not remove them, especially where no regularized geometry exists in that
area. If you omit geometries that are under review, you omit sourcing area.

### `paraguay-parcelas-activas/paraguay_parcelas_activas.parquet`

2,192,890 polygons, downloaded 17 July 2026. The source publishes no capture
date for this layer.

`dpto` is a single-letter department code, not a name. `obs` is uncontrolled
free text carried over from the source registry, and the same text repeats
inside `clave_comparacion`, so a filter on `obs` alone does not remove it.

### `uruguay-pais-rural/uruguay_pais_rural.parquet`

250,074 polygons, as of 2 February 2025. It replaces the former root-level
`Uruguay_PaisRural.parquet`. `AREAHA` is an integer, so a parcel under one
hectare rounds; `AREAMC` is a double in square metres.

## Older Objects Still Served

Two prefixes under this product predate the catalog and are not part of it:

- `temp/` — a Goiás sample CSV and a subset Parquet left from the build
- `pageresources/` — the three images this page embeds

`pageresources/` is in use. `temp/` is referenced by nothing.
